summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Business Files document vault feature. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: tile navigation, upload form, document list, folder tabs, tag filters, search, edit form, delete confirmation all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend documents.py correctly implements admin-only access via get_admin_user dependency
Backend upload endpoint properly handles multipart/form-data with file, folder, tags, display_name
Backend search endpoint correctly searches across display_name, filename, tags, folder, and extracted_text
Backend folders endpoint returns all default folders (Banking, Licenses, Insurance, Tax, Legal, Receipts, Other) with counts
Backend tags endpoint returns unique tags with counts using MongoDB aggregation
Backend PATCH endpoint correctly updates display_name, folder, and tags fields
Backend DELETE endpoint properly removes documents from database
Backend file/preview endpoints require token query parameter for authentication
Frontend BusinessFilesPage.jsx correctly uses data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Frontend upload form includes folder select, name input, tags input, and drag/drop area
Frontend document row shows display_name, folder badge, tags, file size, date, and action buttons
Frontend edit form allows changing display_name, folder, and tags with save/cancel buttons
Frontend delete requires confirmation before removing document
Frontend folder tabs and tag filters correctly filter documents
Frontend search input searches documents with debounce
seed_data_creation: Test documents created during backend tests (cleaned up automatically). Existing document: Chase Checking Account (Banking folder, tags: chase, checking)
